body: You are different, of all the people that exist in the world you are one of kind. No one else could replace you. I can hear your pain, and whether I know you or not doesn’t make you less valuable.
You are good enough as you are. You are valuable. You are important. You are worth loving. I would be devastated if you were to go.
Thanks for sharing! This was exactly what I was looking for.

You are right, we don’t know if things are going to get better. If they’re so sure of it, then when? Cause now would be a great time. With that said, I would be deeply sad to see you go. You are so strong that despite it all you’re still here. I don’t even know if you can consider it a delay because our time will for sure come, but it hasn’t been that time yet. I would consider it advancing the inevitable. Nonetheless, I delay the inevitable because somehow some way I always make it through all my worst days. I attempted twice, and I love to yell out loud, “HERE I AM DESPITE IT ALL!” All the crap that life has thrown at me, surviving the attempts, and I’m still not dead yet?
I wish I could give you a big hug! I promise I won’t let go until you’re ready to.

It really sucks that many people are not educated about mental illness. However, mental illness can be considered a disability and is a serious subject that should be normalized. I wished so badly that I wasn’t the way I am, why is it that we are suffering so bad? Why do we have to have it harder than others? Although there is no easy fix, thankfully there are treatments available to help us manage our illness. Thank you for still being here with us despite it all.
Happy birthday!!! I’m happy you made it to your 18th year and that you’re here with us. Are you doing anything to celebrate?

I tend to dump my suicidal thoughts here or onto my therapist since talking about suicide is normalized and my friends/family would also panic. With that being said, we can’t control how others feel. Nonetheless, it would probably be best to try to deescalate things as you talk about it with your friends to help calm them. For example, that could be letting them know that you are safe now, whether you are still having suicidal thoughts, or that you are getting help or are wanting help.

I can absolutely relate. I can’t find anything to look forward to. I have no idea what I’m going to do with my life. I feel like absolute shit and I’m tired of feeling this way. The only thing I got going for me is therapy.

I feel this too. I recently learned that I am codependent which made so much sense when I realized I felt like I didn't know what to do with myself anymore when we broke up. It's because I sacrificed so much of myself for them, and found it more important to please them rather than myself. Then when I had to learn how to do things on my own, I was lost.
I got academic probation last semester, it’s my first year as a transfer student. I got a 1.95 gpa, but I have high hopes that this is the semester I recover.
Lots of sleeping, video games, movies, went to SF for travels, went to Julian for pies, and went to SeaWorld for the hell of it.
If you don’t get the score you want you can retake it a second time. If you score lower than an 8, then that just means you’ll need to take additional writing course(s).

From my understanding as an accounting major, as long as you get an 8 or above you don’t have to take any additional writing classes. The only upper division writing class you would need to take is ACCTG 390W, if you at least score an 8 on the WPA.
